input.quote: (g) not use the Work to act as a service bureau in whole or in part, for any other Person, except for any affiliate of Sparkling operating at the Authorized Locations.
input.rationale: The Agreement grants Garman no audit, inspection or verification right over Sparkling. Section 3 (Restrictions on Use) ends at limb (g) with use covenants only and no accompanying right for Garman to audit licence compliance, count copies or access Sparkling's systems; Section 20 (General Matters) contains only time-of-essence and notice provisions, and searches for "audit", "inspect", "verify", "premises" and "remote" return no audit-type right binding us. The only examination right in the document runs in our favour (Section 16 escrow: "Sparkling may itself or by retaining independent experts, examine and test the materials for compliance with the obligations of Garman"), and Section 14 confidentiality protects accounting records to which either party obtains access. With no audit right against the Customer, there is nothing exceeding the preferred position on frequency, notice, cost or system access, so the outcome is better than preferred and no redline is warranted — inviting an audit clause would create an exposure we do not currently have.
